methodology_note: Cross-source: NCRB PSI 2022 prisoner counts (STATES+UTs subtotals across all 4 categories: convicts + undertrials + detenues + other prisoners) divided by Census 2011 national religious population times 100,000. Caveat: Maharashtra did not report religion breakdown for ~33k undertrials/detenues — religion-reported numerator excludes those; full national population is the denominator. Actual Muslim rate is mildly understated.
